Set up gossip

On approach
- Gossip
Hello and welcome to the Darkmoon Faire Staging Area.

The portal here will take you to the Darkmoon Faire.

But if you have any questions before you go, I can answer them.

Mysteries and wonders surround us every day, not just at the faire. We've compiled a list of some of the wonders you may encounter in your every day business. The Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide will help you navigate the wonders of the world.

With the guide in your possession, you may come across items you never knew existed. Items you may have taken for granted in the past are now treasures that others long for.

Keep the guide with you, and keep your eyes open for mystery.

If you happen to lose your guide, seek us out and we will replace it for free.

The player receives a Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide

An excellent question! We have many things for sale at the faire. If you are interested in food or drink, then visit Stamp of Sylannia's booths.

If you'd rather purchase something more exotic, then Lhara may have just the thing for you. She specializes in rarities from all over the world.

And then there is Flik running around here somewhere. If you can grab him he sells balls for throwing and frogs to keep as pets.

Glad you asked. Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets are your currency to purchase some amazing prizes.

Prize Tickets are rewarded for doing monthly quests and playing the games around the faire.

Completing the monthly quests will earn you the most prize Tickets, but playing the games daily, is a great way to get ahead.

Once you have enough tickets, you can spend them at the differend vendors on the faire grounds.

No one really knows who made the Darkmoon Cards or what their true purpose is, but i can tell you that they have been found all over Azeroth, usually in the hands of a villain attempting to unlock their mysteries.

There are eight types of Darkmoon Cards: Beast, Blessings, Elementals, Furies, Lunacy, Portals, Storms and Warlords, with eight cards, Ace to Eight in each suit. If you collect all eight of one suit then you can turn them into a deck that you can give to our Professor Thaddeus Paleo in exchange for a powerful trinket.

The Darkmoon Faire is filled with all sorts of amazing attractions. We have a fortune teller, a concert, a fishing context and a lot of games.

We are constantly expanding the faire with all manner of new attractions!

Are there any attractions you'd like more information on?

Miniature tanks, or Tonks as we've cleverly named them, have been a faire favorite for as long as I can remember.

We have two arenas dedicated for tonk battles.

One are pits you against the clock as you race to destroy targets, and avoid the enemy tonks. You just need a game token to play!

The other are is a place where you can use your own tonks or MiniZeps to battle your friends.

The Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon is a state-of-the-art single person projectile device.

Delivering its payload at near the speed of a dragon, the cannon is the pride and joy of the Blastenheimer family, world renowned for their aeronautical and combustible feats!

If you'd like to be launched through the skies to fly free as a bird, seek out Maxima Blastenheimer.

Whack-a-Gnoll is a fun-filled game of whacking... gnolls.

It's a new attraction, and quite popular among us... Well, Sayge isn't too fond of it.

We like to make sure that faire goers of all ages can enjoy the games.

Ring Toss is a simple game whee you try to land a ring on the back of a moving turtle.

It's one of my favorite games to play.

Rinling runs the shooting gallery.

There are only three targets to hit, and the faster you are, the better you do.

Personally, it's one of my favorite games.

I highly recommend that you visit Sayge to get your fortune told.

I know, I know... he's a gnoll. But he's a very special gnoll with the power to divine your future!

Silas Darkmoon is the founder and leader of the Darkmoon Faire, an exotic bunch of wandering showmen, who together celebrate the wondrous and mysterious idiosyncrasies found in Azeroth. Previously operating in Mulgore and Elwynn Forest, his Faire has since the time of Deathwing's fall moved to Darkmoon Island.

sections.Legends: Blood Runs Thicker:
At some point Silas and his crew visited Southshore for performance.

When Kerri Hicks was wrongfully accused by Cedrick Fallrook of his brother Erik Fallrook's murder, Silas and the rest of the Darkmoon Faire worked together to prove her innocence. When it became impossible for them to do so in time to prevent Kerri's execution, they opted instead for breaking her out of jail. Though successful, they were caught before they could escape. Luckily, it was revealed that Yebb Neblegear had found a witness that proved Kerri's innocence, and Kerri and the rest of the Darkmoon Faire were free to go.

Later on, Silas and the rest of the Faire would abduct the murderer Cedrick from his home after he had been banished by his father, enforcing their own brand of justice by stuffing Cedrick inside his brother's coffin and burying him alive. Silas would not stand for violence on his fairegrounds, but nor would he forgive slights against his "family of freaks".

Those who visit the capital city of the tauren know better than to misbehave.

Bluffwatchers are guards located throughout the tauren city of Thunder Bluff. They can provide directions to various locations in town. They are also aboard the Zephyr.

sections.Quotes:
- Gossip
What are you looking for?

It is found on the lowest section of Thunder Bluff. Search near the bank. It is not far from there.

The Thunder Bluff Bank can be found on the lower rise.

Which trainer do you seek?
- Greetings honored one. Turak Runetotem and the other druids have been expecting you at the Hall of Elders on Elder Rise.
- Seek out Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise.
- Ahh, you will need to make your way over to the Hunter's Hall then. Several great hunters like Holt Thunderhorn can be found there on the Hunter Rise.
- Any friend of the animals is a friend of mine. The Hunter's Hall is what you seek. It sits atop the Hunter Rise.
- A follower of the arcane are you? Hmph! Very well then... you can find them around the Pools of Vision underneath the Spirit Rise.
- Very sad to think what has befallen those poor undead souls. You can find Archmage Shymm reflecting near the Pools of Vision under the Spirit Rise.
You will find the Sunwalker's Lodge on Hunter's Rise.
The Seers of Elder Rise will help you. Seek them out in the Hall of Elders there.
Boarton Shadetotem's the one you want. He showed up one day and insisted he had been around the whole time. I don't know how he manages to be so quiet with such enormous hooves, but he sure can sneak up on you!

You should be able to find him in the Hunter Rise, if he feels like being seen today.
- The Earth Mother calls and you answer. You will find the Hall of Spirits on the Spirit Rise.
- The Hall of Spirits is where our shamans call home. You can find it on the Spirit Rise. May your ancestors watch over you.
Aspiring to join our ranks one day? Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way. He's in the Hunter's Hall.
You will find Tseh Rah on the Spirit Rise. She has been meeting with the Shaman Trainers there.

- A fellowship of kindred spirits can be a powerful force. Krumn will help you to achieve this. You will find him at the Thunder Bluff Civic Information center on the lower rise next to the lifts.
- Krumn is the bull you are looking for. He can be found on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Civic Information.

Look for Innkeeper Pala in the building just south of the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.

You can find a mailbox just outside the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.

Which profession?
- The herbs found in nature can be a powerful ally when combined with respect. You will want to seek out Bena at her alchemy shop on the middle rise to further your training.
- Then head over to Bena's Alchemy on the middle rise and talk to Bena herself. She will be able to help you master the art of potion browing.
Otoh Greyhide spends much of time in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise. Seek him out there, and he will help you.
Looking how to learn to work an anvil and hammer, eh? Karn Stonehoof can teach you how. He has a smithy set up on the lower rise by the pond.
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner. Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here. Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.
- Drat... now I am hungry.
- You honor the spirits of the animals you must slay by not letting them go to waste. Aska Mistrunner will show you how. She has a kitchen on the high rise.
- Check out Dawnstrider Enchanters on the middle rise then. Teg will be more than happy to help you in whatever way he can.
- The profession of Enchanting displays the cycle of destruction and creation that is at the heart of nature. Teg at the Dawnstrider Enchanters on the middle rise will show you how.
You must be looking for Palehoof, who keeps our elevators and windmills in good working order. Find him upon the lower rise.
First Aid is always a nice skill to have. Many a time during battle has it saved my hide. Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise. Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.
Don't blame you for taking up fishing. Mulgore has some of the best fishing spots in Southern Kalimdor and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise has all of the gear you'll need to take advantage of it.

Tell Kah Mistrunner that I sent ya!
- Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism is the one you want to talk to then. He can be found on the middle rise.
- Nature provides all that we need. Speak to Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism on the middle rise.
Seek out Poshken Hardbinder in The Pools of Vision, below the Spirit Rise.
Seek the Cloudchasers upon the lower rise. They should be able to help you in all matters of jewelcrafting.
Go see Una at Thunder Bluff Armorers then. It can be found on the middle rise.
- The Earth Mother holds many secrets and Brek Stonehoof can help you to discover some of them. You will find him on the lower rise at Stonehoof Geology.
- Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.
Mooranta can help you learn skinning. She can be found just outside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.
Tepa is renown for her clothwork. She can be found at Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

- It is the assistance of Bulrug that you need. You will find him outside on the lower rise standing between the inn and the Thunder Bluff Bank.
- The cornern that you show for the welfare of your animal companions is commendable. Bulrug, on the lower rise, can help you with that. Seek him out between the bank and the inn.

The Wind Rider Roost is atop the totem stairway in the center of town.

Located here in Mulgore we do not have many options for travel but I will help you as best I can.

Where are you looking to travel?
You'll find Krendle Bigpockets near the zeppelin's perch on the western edge of Spirit Rise. I'm not fond of the goblin contraption flying through here... but it will take you to Orgrimmar if you can stand it. From Orgrimmar you can risk another zeppelin to Undercity or Silvermoon City in the Eastern Kingdoms or one to Warsong Hold in Northrend.
A portal can be found in the cave beneath Spirit Rise that will take you to the wasteland of Hellfire Peninsula in Outland.

sections.History:
During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Reha joined the reborn Knights of the Silver Hand in the Sanctum of Light beneath Light's Hope Chapel. In the Hall of Champions, he attended the funeral ceremony of Tirion Fordring and witnessed Lord Maxwell Tyrosus' reestablishment of the Order of the Silver Hand. Afterward, he was seen tending to the wounded soldiers in the Armory of the Silver Hand.

Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, he is no longer a member of the Silver Hand.

Years later, Reha was among the forces of the Vanguard of the Light fighting against the Devouring Host in Parhelion Plaza on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Reha appears at the celebration camp in Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris during the Midsummer Fire Festival. He can be seen speaking with a Midsummer Celebrant.

sections.Description: Tahu Sagewind is a powerful tauren seer and the founder of the Seers, an order of tauren priests who revere the wisdom of the Earthmother as illuminated by the Light of the sun god An'she.
sections.Wrath of the Lich King: During the war against the Lich King, in the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff, Tahu and his friend Aponi Brightmane started to ponder upon the nature of the Earth Mother and how tauren have been druids since the start of time. However, all they knew about druidism was from the teachings of the night elves, which are creatures of the night. The other eye of the Earth Mother, An'she - the sun - was, however, completely forgotten. The pair concluded that the night elves, through their ties to tauren druids, passed on their cultural prejudice against the sun to their tauren students. As Tahu realized this, he pondered what could happen should tauren start to harness the power of the sun granted by the second eye of the Earth Mother. It was this small realization that set in motion the genesis of the tauren priests and the paladin order. In time, Aponi abandoned her warrior ways and became the first tauren paladin in an order now known as the Sunwalkers, while Tahu ended up abandoning his druidic path and became the first tauren priest.
sections.Cataclysm: Following the Cataclysm, the priesthood known as the Seers was officially created, and Tahu became a priest trainer, instructing young tauren seers.
sections.Legion: During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, after Dalaran relocated above the Broken Isles, Tahu Sagewind could be seen accompanied by Orik Trueheart. The dwarf paladin had asked the Sunwalkers to aid him in his quest to locate the :Truthguard, and it was Tahu who offered him to use his ability to speak with the long departed during their search, following a vrykul saga. As such, Orik and Tahu went to Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord. There, Tahu attuned his stone to the scroll Orik brought and had the paladin adventurer search the graves, looking for Gorvold Ironbrow with the :Aura Stone. When they found Gorvold's grave, Tahu conducted a ritual that summoned the spirit and cleansed him, and once Orik received the information he needed, Tahu returned to the Netherlight Temple to inform the Conclave of their success.
sections.The War Within: Following the destruction of Dalaran, Tahu accompanied the Horde forces that traveled to the Isle of Dorn to aid in the war against Xal'atath. He could be found talking with Aponi Brightmane at the landing site.
sections.Midnight:
Tahu was part of the Vanguard of the Light summoned to defend the Sunwell from Xal'atath and fought against the Devouring Host at Parhelion Plaza. After the initial assault was fought off, Tahu was one of the Light-wielders who was continuously channeling Light into the Sunwell to keep the Voidstorm at bay.

Tahu appears at the celebration camp in Thistleshrub Valley in Tanaris during the Midsummer Fire Festival. He can be seen speaking with the Fiery Image of Elder Sunhorn.

title: Tamaala

sections.Description:
Tamaala was the lifemate of Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof and the mother of Baine Bloodhoof. She died some time before the events of the Third War and, according to Cairne's recollection, was a very spiritual person with a big heart and good perception. Cairne also noted that Baine took after her in that regard.

After dying from an incurable illness, her soul remained on Azeroth to watch over Cairne and Baine. She briefly met with Cairne on his passing, and he, too, decided to stay, awaiting Baine with Tamaala.

Years later, during the Fourth War, a malevolent spirit rose up to attack Mulgore. Consequently, Baine Bloodhoof and a powerful champion of the tauren people stood together before the chieftain's tent in Thunder Bluff to banish it, but as Baine called on it to be destroyed, the spirits of Cairne and Tamaala appeared before him. His father reminded him that the tauren way was harmony, not destruction, and that light and shadow were both needed to see what lay before them. Thanks to Baine and the champion, the spirits were in balance again. Baine asked if his parents could stay longer, as he had so much to tell them; but Cairne gently told him that he knew, but that conversation would have to be for another time. As they returned to the Spirit World, Cairne expressed pride in his son, and admonished him to remember that the Earth Mother watched over him as did he and Tamaala.
